description:
Site configuration plus evidence; open a PR only for fixes.

1. Set the site Pages custom domain to next.benchbox.dev via gh api. Poll the Pages API every 2 minutes, for at most 60 minutes, until the certificate is approved, then enforce HTTPS. On timeout, remove the domain and stop.
2. Set SITE_DEPLOY_TARGET=rehearsal.
3. Run one deploy from a push to main and one from a core-bundle dispatch. Check:
   - every route class: /, /docs/, /docs/dev/, /blog/ and /results/;
   - 404.html and objects.inv;
   - every page carries noindex, and the origin gate passed.
4. Rollback drill: dispatch mode=rollback to the first rehearsal receipt, check the probes, then deploy forward again.
5. Failure path: a workflow_dispatch whose payload carries a wrong digest must not deploy, and must open or update the site-bundle-failed issue in core. "Newest certified" comes from core runs, so this test cannot poison later resolves.
